personality_one_liner: Trustworthy, highly-legible iOS-native layout with natural botanical tones to frame specialist expertise and AI diagnostics.

spacing.rule: Generous iOS-native padding. Use margins to separate logical blocks. Thumb zone matters for CTAs.

do's: Sticky bottom CTA container on scrolling screens

screens.name: Home (Camera Scan)
screens.purpose: Live camera capture with AI diagnostics leading to a DIY vs Pro decision.

states.loading: Pulsing reticle overlay on camera feed.
states.empty: Camera ready, waiting for object in frame.
states.error: Modal sheet with retry button and troubleshooting steps.

screens.layout: Camera view fills the safe area. A reticle sits in the center. Upon object detection, a continuous bounding box is drawn around the prominent object with a confidence label. A modal bottom sheet slides up showing AI results: step-by-step DIY instructions with color-coded difficulty (Green=DIY, Red=Pro) and materials list. A sticky bottom CTA 'Call Specialist' is anchored above the home indicator.

screens.name: Specialists
screens.purpose: Browse and filter trusted local tradespeople.

states.empty: Illustration of a toolbox with 'No specialists found for this category'.

screens.layout: Horizontal filter chips (Plumbing, Electrical, Carpentry) below the header. Vertical list of specialist cards. Each card fills 100% of horizontal width minus padding, containing avatar, name, trade, rating, and verified badge. Tapping opens Specialist Profile.

screens.name: Specialist Profile
screens.purpose: Build trust and facilitate booking via portfolio and ratings.

states.empty: No portfolio items message inside gallery.

screens.layout: Full-bleed hero portrait or gallery with vertical gradient-to-dark scrim. Prominent trust badges (Verified, 4.9 stars) below the header. 'About' section, 'Portfolio' horizontal scroll of real past work. Persistent sticky 'Contact' (Chat / Call / Request) CTA at the bottom within a glassmorphic container.

screens.name: Messages
screens.purpose: In-app chat list and active conversations.
screens.layout: Standard iOS list rhythm. Leading avatar, title, unread dot, trailing timestamp. Chat detail screen has a fixed input area at bottom inside KeyboardAvoidingView.

screens.name: Profile
screens.purpose: Settings, language toggle, and specialist registration.
screens.layout: Grouped list items using surfaceSecondary on a surface background. Toggle for languages (Italian/Spanish). 'Register as Specialist' row leading to a multi-step form.

hero_scan_bg.alt: Close up of a leaking pipe in a wall

specialist_avatar_1.alt: Portrait of a smiling professional handyman

instructions_to_main_agent: Use the 1 iOS-Native Clean personality. Prioritize readable typography, generous spacing, and deep botanical greens as the primary brand color to build trust and convey 'safe home'.
STRICT NO BLUES OR PURPLES. We are using forest/sage green as the primary brand color (#2D4A22).

In the Home (Scan) screen, utilize a full-screen camera view with an overlaid Reticle. Once diagnosed, present the AI Gemini 3 Flash results inside a gorhom/bottom-sheet modal. Color code the difficulty (DIY=Green, Pro=Red) to help users decide.

For Specialist profiles, use full-bleed hero photos with a vertical gradient scrim (transparent to #1C1B19 at the bottom) so white text stays readable. Place a fixed 'Contact' CTA at the bottom in a glassmorphic container.
Ensure all lists use 100% width padded cards, and any sticky bottom CTA must float safely above the home indicator, allowing content to scroll behind it.
Incorporate a language toggle (Italian/Spanish) in the Profile screen settings.
All tap targets must be at least 44x44pt. Use Pressable with proper hitSlop where necessary.
